prompt:

Header text verbatim: "mycket". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "highly".
Scene: Colleagues warmly acknowledging a respected coworker at a meeting, sincere appreciative expressions.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "mycket = highly in this expression of respect.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Hon är mycket respekterad av sina kollegor.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
